name: FLA_LEASES_ALL
description: FLA_LEASES_ALL contains lease information such as type of the lease, name of the lease, number, and lease start date, and so on.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: Lease number which is either automatically generated or entered by the user, based on the system setup option.

columns.name: LEASE_NAME
columns.description: Lease name to identify the lease.

columns.name: LEASE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease is active. It is same as the lease commencement date for the first draft. It is not modifiable, once the lease is finalized.

columns.name: LEASE_ASSET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the lease asset is of Equipment or Property type.

columns.name: LEASE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lease status. Possible values are Active, Terminated, and Hold.

columns.name: CONTRACT_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease contract is active.

columns.name: CONTRACT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease contract is inactive.

columns.name: MIGRATED_LEASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease is migrated or imported from an external system.

columns.name: MIGRATION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date when the lease was migrated in.

columns.name: OPTION_LEVEL_ALLOWED_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if option is defined at asset or lease level.

columns.name: IMPORT_TARGET_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Target status of the lease that is imported. Values could be Active, Draft & Complete.

columns.name: ABSTRACTED_BY
columns.description: User ID who has done the booking and can be different from CREATED_BY

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the lease contract.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the amortization has to be considered.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_PRORATION_CODE
columns.description: Proration method to identify the number of days to consider per month to prorate the amount

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Vendor identifier which represents the lessor associated with the lease.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INCREASE_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease can have payment increase agreements.

columns.name: LEASE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the lease type. Valid values are EXPENSE, REVENUE and SUBLEASE.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier. This is the party or lessee for the lease.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lease is a sublease. This is applicable for a revenue lease.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier of the headlease. This is applicable if this lease is a sublease.

columns.name: ENABLE_SUBLEASES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if subleases are allowed on this lease. This is applicable for an expense lease.

columns.name: ROU_MIGRATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Right of use migration basis. Indicates if the right of use balance should be entered as a gross or net amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
